paragraphs: At shift handover, first review reports and handover records and confirm each pump's status. During the day shift, adjust flow according to process instructions and coordinate with downstream operations. In the afternoon, inspect pump bodies, listen for unusual sounds, and check seals. At night, monitor central-control screens, watch trends, and receive alarms. When an abnormality occurs, switch to backup equipment first, report it, and document the event clearly.

It suits practical, procedure-oriented, composed people who enjoy the reassurance of keeping an entire system operating reliably.
